description: This file defines a static class InvokablePool that manages object pooling for IInvokable implementations, providing methods to get and return pooled objects.

classes.name: InvokablePool
classes.description: A static class providing object pooling for IInvokable implementations.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an IInvokable object of type T from the pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns an IInvokable object of type T to the pool.
